correctness.rationale: The code data match Example 4.3. Primary decomposition gives active dimensions \(3\) and \(1\). For the first component, \((x+i)(x-i)=x^2+1\) produces a rank-one word, its shift gives a rank-two two-dimensional subcode, and expansion of the full generator over \(\mathbb F_3\) spans all four support coordinates, so its hierarchy is \((1,2,4)\). The second component has hierarchy \((1)\). The exact convolution yields \((1,2,3,5)\). The packaged verifier independently replays every finite algebraic step.
